items.title: John G. Curran Interview, 1958-05-13
items.q: I know that Somerset has said that he has played the Des Boutons and he has played for the Des Boutons' grandmothers

ctx.x: social, social, the social efforts of New Orleans you ask about New Orleans?

Well, I don't get to really very much to add to your interview other than I know that Somerset has said that he has played the Des Boutons and he has played for the Des Boutons' grandmothers after they were parted in New Orleans. He did play in New Orleans over a period of 50 years. And he was accepted as a real heritage in New Orleans of all the college musicians. Because he was the one single leader who refused to leave New Orleans for more than 30 days. And he never lived in New Orleans and got it for how much…
Would you have to hire the one jazz or one of the songs?
